title: Taking Deposits on a work order needs Invoicing & payments Create & Edit
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON.
  2. User A has Invoicing & payments View only; User B has Invoicing & payments Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. As User A, open a work order in Estimate or In progress state and look for a Deposit action.
  2. As User B, open the same kind of work order and look for the Deposit action.
  3. Enter a deposit amount and confirm.
custom_expected:
The Deposit action is not shown for User A.

The Deposit action is shown for User B and the deposit is recorded on the work order.
